name: std-crew-board-2d
description: 2D multi-unit crew-management board FRAME: composes hero-nav (unit-by-id move authority, no combat) + fx-particles onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render and select/deselect/move intent. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/tiles via config.

schema.name: std-crew-board-2d
schema.description: 2D multi-unit crew-management board FRAME: composes hero-nav (unit-by-id move authority, no combat) + fx-particles onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render and select/deselect/move intent. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/tiles via config.

emits.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

events.name: Hero Stepped
events.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

moveBudget.label: Move Budget
moveBudget.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain

gridHeight.label: Grid Height
gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + wander bounds

gridWidth.label: Grid Width
gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)

units.label: Initial Units
units.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

decayRate.label: Decay Rate
decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

fx.label: Initial Fx
fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

frames.label: Frame names
frames.description: Atlas sub-texture names cycled into @entity.frameName, one per tick; empty disables name cycling.
frames.synonyms: sprite names, atlas frames, animation frames

emits.description: Crew move intent applied by the hero-nav authority
Emits UI:{tileClickEvent} with { x, y } on tile click
Emits UI:{unitClickEvent} with { unitId } on unit click

events.name: Unit Click
events.description: Emits UI:{unitClickEvent} with { unitId } on unit click

events.name: Tile Click
events.description: Emits UI:{tileClickEvent} with { x, y } on tile click

events.name: Move
events.description: Crew move intent applied by the hero-nav authority

features.label: Features
features.description: Decorative environment features (e.g. consoles) drawn on the board.

oxygenIcon.label: Oxygen Icon
oxygenIcon.description: Icon asset for the Oxygen HUD stat.

showMinimap.label: Show Minimap
showMinimap.description: Whether the canvas draws a minimap.

movementRange.label: Movement Range
movementRange.description: Max manhattan distance a selected crew unit may move.

cancelIcon.label: Cancel Icon
cancelIcon.description: Icon asset for the Cancel button.

fxPresets.label: Fx Presets
fxPresets.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type; its composed mechanics currently emit none, so the channel is forward-compat only.

oxygen.label: Oxygen
oxygen.description: Initial HUD oxygen display value. Cosmetic only: the source board never depletes it, so no atom writes it after INIT.

crewCount.label: Crew Count
crewCount.description: Initial HUD crew-count display value. Cosmetic only: the source board never changes it after INIT.

crewIcon.label: Crew Icon
crewIcon.description: Icon asset for the Crew HUD stat.
